name: WeedsGalore: Multispectral and Multitemporal UAV Crop and Weed Dataset
description: WeedsGalore is a high-resolution multispectral and multitemporal UAV image benchmark for crop and weed semantic and instance segmentation in agricultural maize fields, published by the GFZ German Research Centre for Geosciences, Humboldt-Universität zu Berlin, and Karlsruhe Institute of Technology (KIT). Recorded across multiple growth stages in Germany using a 5-band multispectral sensor (RGB, Red-Edge, NIR) at a ground sampling distance of 2.5 mm/pixel, the dataset features 156 high-density tiles with dense pixel-level annotations for maize and 4 prominent weed species.
